Amida.name: Amida
Amida.summary: Amida is a Japanese ladder climbing puzzle video game. The game requires players to navigate the main character safely across several pre-set bridges. Each bridge is composed of a number of obstacles that the character will blindly navigate into. The player can utilize an animated platform to redirect the main character as they move through the stage.

Purikura Pocket 2 - Kareshi Kaizou Daisa.name: Purikura Pocket 2: Kareshi Kaizou Daisakusen
Purikura Pocket 2 - Kareshi Kaizou Daisa.summary: A simulation game released in 1997. The goal is to mold a boyfriend to your liking before graduation.

Shippuu! Iron Leaguer.name: Shippuu! Iron Leaguer
Shippuu! Iron Leaguer.summary: Game Boy game based on the 1990s Sunrise sports robot anime.

Torpedo Range.name: Torpedo Range
Torpedo Range.summary:
In Torpedo Range, terrorists have basically somehow taken over most of
the world. As a one-ship operation, you have to free six countries from the
terrorists' grasp to win the game: to do this, you must visit a port at each of
the six countries and destroy all the guns on the port in a shooting mini-game
to 'liberate' the country.
